name: DeviceLink
description: DeviceLink connects AI assistants to files on your computer, securely and in real-time. Nothing is uploaded - files are streamed directly from your machine only while the agent is running. Share any folder, search your codebase, read files, and list directories, all within boundaries you control. Access is scoped to the folders you choose, credentials and secrets are always blocked, and closing the agent stops everything instantly. Manage team access through organizations and workspaces with role-based permissions and configurable file policies

_published_faq.name: How do I add DeviceLink to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DeviceLink to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.devicelink.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DeviceLink MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DeviceLink provides these MCP tools: device_tool_call, health, and discover.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DeviceLink?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DeviceLink in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
DeviceLink requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DeviceLink is developed by DeviceLink. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
